mapper.select: SELECT itl.id as link_id, itl.issue_id, itl.task_post_id, itl.order_num, itl.created_at as linked_at, tp.id as task_id, tp.title as task_title, tp.folder_id, tp.author_id, tp.created_at as task_created_at, tp.updated_at as task_updated_at FROM issue_task_links itl INNER JOIN task_posts tp ON itl.task_post_id = tp.id WHERE itl.issue_id = #{issueId} AND tp.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY itl.order_num ASC, itl.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO issue_task_links (issue_id, task_post_id, order_num) VALUES (#{issueId}, #{taskPostId}, #{orderNum})
